```artifact
Feature: Doctor and Chemist/Lab Management

  Scenario: Adding a new Doctor
  Given a system with no doctors
  When I add a new doctor with a unique name, age, sex, qualification, experience, and speciality
  Then the doctor should be added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Adding a new doctor with various attributes
  | Name       | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
  | John Doe   | 35  | M   | MD            | 10        | Cardiology  |
  | Jane Smith | 40  | F   | PhD           | 15        | Neurology   |

  Scenario: Viewing and updating doctor details
  Given a system with existing doctors
  When I view a doctor's details
  Then I should see the doctor's current details

  Scenario Outline: Viewing and updating doctor details with various attributes
  | Name       | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
  | John Doe   | 35  | M   | MD            | 10        | Cardiology  |
  | Jane Smith | 40  | F   | PhD           | 15        | Neurology   |

  Scenario: Deleting a doctor
  Given a system with existing doctors and pending consultations
  When I delete a doctor
  Then the doctor should be deleted only if no consultations are pending

  Scenario Outline: Deleting a doctor with various attributes
  | Name       | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
  | John Doe   | 35  | M   | MD            | 10        | Cardiology  |
  | Jane Smith | 40  | F   | PhD           | 15        | Neurology   |

  Scenario: Adding a new Chemist or Lab
  Given a system with no chemists or labs
  When I add a new chemist or lab with a unique pincode
  Then the chemist or lab should be added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Adding a chemist or lab with various pincodes
  | Pincode    |
  | 12345      |
  | 67890      |

  Scenario: Viewing and updating chemist/lab details
  Given a system with existing chemists or labs
  When I view a chemist or lab's details
  Then I should see the chemist or lab's current details

  Scenario Outline: Viewing and updating chemist/lab details with various pincodes
  | Pincode    |
  | 12345      |
  | 67890      |

  Scenario: Deleting a chemist or lab
  Given a system with existing chemists or labs and pending prescriptions
  When I delete a chemist or lab
  Then the chemist or lab should be deleted only if no prescriptions are pending


Feature: Maintaining Chemist and Lab

  Scenario: Adding a new Chemist or Lab
  Given a system with no chemists or labs
  When I add a new chemist or lab with a unique pincode
  Then the chemist or lab should be added to the system

  Scenario Outline: Adding a chemist or lab with various pincodes

  Scenario: Viewing and updating chemist/lab details
  Given a system with existing chemists or labs

  Then I should see the chemist or lab's current details

  Scenario Outline: Viewing and updating chemist/lab details with various pincodes
  | Pincode    |
  | 12345      |
  | 67890      |

  Scenario: Deleting a chemist or lab
  Given a system with existing chemists or labs and pending prescriptions
  When I delete a chemist or lab
  Then the chemist or lab should be deleted only if no prescriptions are pending

```
